From box scores to insight.

A reproducible, historical analysis of the 2024–25 regular season. No live feed, predictions, or simulated statistics.

Sources & scope

Game results and player averages transcribed from Hoop Savant ↗. Team totals cross-checked against Basketball Reference ↗ and game scores against Champs or Chumps ↗.

The December 14 NBA Cup semifinal is classified as neutral-site, verified with NBA.com. 82 regular-season games; playoffs and the NBA Cup final are excluded. Player explorer contains 12 selected rotation players, not the entire roster. Player averages are source-rounded.

Calculations

Win rate = wins ÷ games. Scoring averages = total points ÷ games. Margin = (points scored − points allowed) ÷ games. Filters recompute team metrics; player data stays full-season.
